package e2e

import (
	"context"

	tenantv1 "github.com/zeroroot-ai/gibson/internal/server/daemon/api/gibson/tenant/v1"
)

// A fixture of the guard in e2e_peer_policy_guard_test.go. It calls an RPC that
// the runner policy does not allow, and the guard must name it. The file has the
// extension .txt so that no build reads it.
func callsAnRPCOutsideThePolicy(ctx context.Context) {
	admin := tenantv1.NewAdminTenantServiceClient(nil)
	_, _ = admin.AdminDeleteTenant(ctx, &tenantv1.AdminDeleteTenantRequest{})
}
